Morphicons 1.7.1, MIT, https://www.morphicons.com/ and https://github.com/guillermolg00/morphicons . Pure core bundled from npm morphicons@1.7.1 dist/index.js using esbuild (format=cjs, target=es2018). No DOM/framework driver is included. Core provides buildPlan, resampleIcon, allocOutputs and interpPolar. WeChat renderer is local components/morph-icon, used only by the validation page.
